name: motion-snap-back
title: Snap Back
description: Con trỏ kéo viên thuốc giãn ra, giữ run run, thả ra nó vụt về chỗ bằng lò xo, dây buộc mảnh dần khi căng.

options.cs: damping of the stretch (12: dips to about 0.8)
options.anchor: px from the anchor to the pill (200)

moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio snap-back, written here): Pulled right: x +98 px (demo) and scaleX 1 → 1.5 (scaleY = 1/scaleX) in 550 ms power2.inOut, a 200 ms hold with a ±0.6 px tremble, then release: x returns on a spring (k 420, d 20), scaleX on a looser one (k 420, d 12) dipping to ~0.8 before 1; 4 ghost copies 18 ms apart for 300 ms after release; a tether line thins as it stretches. Params: pull (98 px) · stretch (1.5) · hold (0.2 s) · spring x (k 420, d 20) · spring scale (k 420, d 12).
